question: Funso
defaultDirections: Sankhani yankho lomwe mukuona kuti layankha funsolo. Mukamaliza, dinani {checkAnswer}. Mudzalandira ndemanga yosonyeza ngati yankho lanu ndi lolondola ndi momwe mungapitirire.
